# Kalahari Hertz

> Kalahari Hertz is a leading IT service provider and technology consultancy based in Gaborone, Botswana. We specialize in managed IT services, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, IT governance, and custom website/portal development. We empower businesses, government entities, and NGOs with secure, scalable, and innovative technology solutions.

## Services
- [Managed IT Services](https://kalaharihertz.co.bw/#services): Proactive IT support, network administration, server management, and Microsoft 365 management.
- [Cybersecurity](https://kalaharihertz.co.bw/#services): Risk assessments, vulnerability audits, ISO 27001 compliance readiness, and incident response planning.
- [Website & Portals](https://kalaharihertz.co.bw/#services): Corporate websites, e-commerce platforms, customer portals, and HR management systems.
- [Cloud & M365](https://kalaharihertz.co.bw/#services): Microsoft 365 deployment, Azure cloud solutions, SharePoint, and Teams administration.
- [IT Governance](https://kalaharihertz.co.bw/#services): IT policies, risk registers, compliance audits, and technology assessments.
- [Printer Rentals](https://kalaharihertz.co.bw/#services): High-performance printer rentals and managed print services for businesses in Botswana.
